evaluation.baseline: mean league-scored production in the last four recorded pre-origin games
evaluation.limitation: Repeated players and overlapping forecast windows are dependent. Weighted descriptive errors, not independent trials, causal estimates or a promotion gate.
evaluation.scoring_scope: evaluated under gabagool scoring, which matches this league

trade.scenario: Conditional starting-lineup comparison; not expected realized gain or a trade verdict

assumptions.scoringScope: Existing weekly-model stat subset with league weights; not every platform scoring event is forecast.

warnings: All non-excluded active players are assumed available, including reported injuries; availability is not predicted.
No keeper, future-pick, waiver-replacement, bench insurance or the other side's willingness to deal.
Sum of weekly lineup central scenarios, not a season median or calibrated uncertainty interval.
Current-week games are excluded. Verify processing time, platform eligibility and future roster constraints.
